chunks: Those who have been given knowledge realise what has been revealed by the Lord is the truth, and leads to the path of the mighty and praiseworthy (God).

key_terms.الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ: Those who have been given knowledge

ai.seo_question: Who recognizes the truth of divine revelation according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who possess the 'Ilm (divine knowledge) necessary to validate the Prophet's message against the doubts of the masses. It underscores their role as the ultimate guides who lead believers to the 'Sirat al-Aziz al-Hamid', emphasizing that true knowledge is not merely intellectual but a spiritual conduit to divine authority.
